technical.summary: Short-term bullish setup with golden cross and AO confirmation, but overbought conditions and weak intermediate trend structure limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 99 days present elevated risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signals; congressional activity is stale (3+ years old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (282.6) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; energy sector may benefit from falling USD but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with AO confirmation and supertrend bullish alignment provide short-term momentum entry signal with defined support at 40.70.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (72.92) and stochastic (82.14) combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 misaligned, ADX 18.19), and zero fundamental support create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry ahead of CPI event.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term momentum (EMA 9/21 golden cross, AO confirmation) but entry quality is moderate with price in middle of range and overbought conditions (RSI 72.92, stoch 82.14) signaling near-term pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (282.6), and CPI event in 2 days create macro headwinds that outweigh short-term technical setup; earnings in 99 days add execution risk with zero fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical bull case overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, sentiment void, and macro crisis conditions
decision.portfolio_note: Already 49 positions in Energy sector (15.6% of portfolio); adding EQT increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without offsetting conviction.
